info.name: Dahab Backend API
info.description: API collection for the Dahab Backend (Laravel 12 + Sanctum). Organized by domain folder to mirror routes/api.php. Two API surfaces with separate tokens: Customer API (/api/v1/customer/*, customer tokens) and Dashboard API (/api/v1/dashboard/*, staff tokens). A token of the other principal is rejected with 401; an access token on a refresh endpoint (or a refresh token on an access endpoint) is rejected with 403. Keep this file updated whenever an endpoint is added, changed, or removed — see postman/README.md.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Dashboard API. Uses staff tokens only (staff_access_token / staff_refresh_token); a customer token is rejected with 401. Sign in with Staff Login (local accounts <role>@dahab.test after `php artisan db:seed`, password seeded-password-1). Founders and staff holding a role flagged requires_mfa (ceo/coo/finance in the seed) never get a session from Staff Login: it answers mfa_required (enrolled) or mfa_enrollment_required (first time) with a session_ref, saved to staff_mfa_session_ref — finish with Staff MFA Verify or Staff MFA Enroll.

request.description: Email + password. 200 with data.session (roles without MFA), OR data.mfa_required, OR data.mfa_enrollment_required (otpauth_url + one-time recovery_codes). 401 invalid_credentials is identical for unknown email, wrong password and a disabled account; 403 account_frozen; 429 account_locked after 5 failures / 30 min per email (auth.staff.login).

Completes an mfa_required sign-in. Send the current 6-digit TOTP as code, or a single-use recovery_code instead of code. session_ref is single-use and expires after 5 minutes. 401 mfa_invalid for a wrong/replayed code or a dead session_ref; 429 after 5 attempts per session_ref (auth.staff.mfa).

Completes an mfa_enrollment_required sign-in: scan the otpauth_url from Staff Login in an authenticator app, then send its current 6-digit code. Nothing is stored until the code is right. Returns the session and the one-time recovery_codes. 401 mfa_invalid; 429 after 5 attempts per session_ref (auth.staff.mfa).
Revokes the current access token and its paired refresh token (204). Uses {{staff_access_token}}.
Revokes every token issued to the staff member (204). Uses {{staff_access_token}}.

Authenticated staff member with their Spatie roles and effective permissions. Uses {{staff_access_token}} (ability staff:access), not the customer access_token (a customer token is rejected with 401) and not the staff refresh token (rejected with 403).

Uses {{staff_refresh_token}} (ability staff:refresh) as the Bearer credential; the staff access token is rejected here with 403. Rotates on every use; replaying an old refresh token returns 401 refresh_invalid and revokes the whole token family.

item.name: Identity
item.description: Dashboard API — identity document review. Uses staff_access_token. Listing/showing/viewing needs identity.view; approving/rejecting needs identity.review (both held by ceo and verification). Every successful View Document Image writes an append-only document_view_log row in the same transaction as the read.

request.description: Oldest-first list. status: pending | verified | needs_resubmission | rejected. Requires identity.view.
Metadata only. Does NOT open the image or log a view.
Returns decrypted image bytes. Writes a document_view_log row inside the same transaction as the read. Response is never cacheable. Requires identity.view.
Same as Front but returns the back side. Returns 410 document_image_deleted if the document has no back page (e.g. a passport).
Approves the document. Customer.status → active; IdentityDocument.status → verified. Dispatches CustomerVerifiedNotification (SMS + email) after commit. Requires identity.review.

Ask again. IdentityDocument.status → needs_resubmission; Customer stays pending_verification. Reasons are required (enum: blurred_or_glare, card_cut_off, name_does_not_match, card_expired, back_missing, text_not_readable). Notification sent after commit.
Rejects the registration. Customer.status → rejected. Reasons are required. Notification sent after commit.
Dashboard "Users and Verification" list. status can be pending_verification / active / rejected / suspended. Requires the staff permission customer.view.
Detail view: customer + every identity document (newest first). Audited (auth.customer.verification_details_viewed). Requires customer.view.

item.name: Access Control
item.description: Dashboard API — roles, their permissions, and staff role assignment (spec 002). Uses staff_access_token. Roles and permissions need roles.manage; the staff list needs staff.view (ceo and coo hold both in the seed). Refusals: 403 escalation_denied (no self-escalation), 409 role_in_use / last_role_manager, 422 reason_required. Frozen staff get 403 account_frozen on every request.

request.description: The code-defined permission catalogue (code, label, group, branch_scoped), ordered by group then code. Read-only: roles hold these codes. Requires roles.manage.
Every role with its permissions and staff_count (system actor excluded), ordered by display_name. Requires roles.manage.

Create a role. name: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,49}$, unique, immutable. display_name max 100, description max 500, requires_mfa boolean, permissions: catalogue codes the actor holds (403 escalation_denied otherwise), reason optional (max 500). Saves role_name. Audited (authz.role.created). Requires roles.manage.
One role by machine name. 404 not_found if unknown. Requires roles.manage.

Edit display_name, description, requires_mfa and/or permissions (replaces the whole set). You cannot edit a role you hold, and every added/removed code must be one you hold (403 escalation_denied). reason (min 5, max 500) is required when permissions or requires_mfa change (422 reason_required). name is ignored. Applies on each holder's next request. Requires roles.manage.
Delete a role nobody holds (409 role_in_use otherwise) and that you do not hold. reason required (422 reason_required). Audited (authz.role.deleted). Requires roles.manage.

Staff members (system actor never listed) with roles, effective permissions, read-only is_founder and branch. Filters: role (a role name), per_page 1-50 (default 25). Saves staff_id from the first row. Requires staff.view.
One staff member. 404 for an unknown id or the system actor. Requires staff.view.

Replace the roles a staff member holds (may be empty). Not on yourself; every permission of every role you add or remove must be one you hold (403 escalation_denied). reason required (422 reason_required). Founder status is never changed. Applies on their next request. Audited (authz.staff.roles_changed). Requires roles.manage.

Sets (an enabled branch) or clears (null) the branch a staff member works at. Not on yourself (403 escalation_denied); reason required (422 reason_required). Applies on their next request. Audited (authz.staff.branch_changed). Requires roles.manage.

item.name: Reference Data
item.description: Dashboard API — karats, inspection branches, weekly hours and closures (spec 004). Uses staff_access_token. Viewing needs reference.view (ceo, coo, finance, operations in the seed); karat on/off needs karats.toggle (finance), adding a karat karats.create (coo), branch and closure changes branches.manage (coo, operations). Refusals: 409 closure_exists / closure_in_past, 422 validation_failed. Every change is audited.

request.description: Every karat in display order, enabled or not. Requires reference.view.
Adds a karat, which starts off. code 1..24 (unique), purity in (0, 1] with at most 5 decimals, optional sort_order (default last). Code and purity never change afterwards. Requires karats.create.
Turns a karat on or off at once. Audited when it changes (reference.karat.toggled). 404 for an unknown code. Requires karats.toggle.
Branches with their weekly hours (dow 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday), enabled or not. Requires reference.view.
Adds a branch with its whole week. Several intervals per day are allowed (split day); they must not overlap (422 hours.N). timezone is an IANA name, default Africa/Cairo. Requires branches.manage.
Edits any field. hours, when sent, replaces the whole week. Disable with is_enabled false; branches are never deleted. Requires branches.manage.
Closures and public holidays, date ascending. branch_id null = every branch. Requires reference.view.
Closes one branch (branch_id) or every branch (branch_id null) for a whole day, today or later. 409 closure_exists for the same date and scope. Requires branches.manage.
Removes a future closure (204). One dated today or earlier is kept: 409 closure_in_past. Requires branches.manage.

item.name: Pricing
item.description: Dashboard API — gold prices, per-karat adjustments and settings (spec 005). Uses staff_access_token. Viewing needs pricing.view (ceo, coo, finance, operations in the seed). Rates, VAT, adjustments and price rules need pricing.rates.manage (finance); deadlines and deposits need settings.manage (coo); a manual price needs gold_price.enter and is accepted only while the price feed is down or not configured; confirming one needs gold_price.confirm (finance) and, while manualprice.confirmer_must_differ is on, another person. Money is a 4-dp string. No provider credential belongs in Postman: the feed is configured in the Backend's .env only.

request.description: The current price, feed state (healthy / down / not_configured), any pending manual price, and every karat's market bid/ask, sellers get, buyers pay, difference and adjustments. Requires pricing.view.
Prices that took effect, newest first. Requires pricing.view.
Every karat's prices for a 24K bid/ask, a change_pct from the current pair, or the current price, optionally with trial adjustments per karat code. Writes nothing. Requires pricing.view.

Both 24K prices (or change_pct) with a reason, only while the feed is down. 201 = effective at once; 202 + code manual_price_confirm_required = pending above manualprice.confirm_deviation_pct. 409 price_feed_healthy while the feed works. Requires gold_price.enter.

Confirms the latest pending manual price within its window. 403 confirmer_must_differ for the person who entered it (when the setting is on); 409 manual_price_not_pending when superseded, lapsed or overtaken. Requires gold_price.confirm.

Replaces 21K's buy-side (sellers get) and sell-side (buyers pay) adjustments: kind fixed (EGP per gram) or percent. 422 price_inverted when buyers would pay less than sellers get. Reason required. Requires pricing.rates.manage.
Adjustment changes, newest first. Requires pricing.view.
Every setting with group (rates / operations), type, unit, range and last change. Requires pricing.view.
A rates key: needs pricing.rates.manage. value is a decimal string (≤ 4 dp) or a boolean for flags. Reason required. Kept in history and audited.
An operations key: needs settings.manage. Whole numbers where the key says integer.
Setting changes, newest first, optionally for one key. Requires pricing.view.

item.name: Audit Log
item.description: Dashboard API — the audit log (spec 006). Uses staff_access_token. audit.view_all (ceo) sees everything; audit.view_own (coo, finance, operations, verification) sees only the caller's own actions. "Everything" (no category) leaves out sign-ins and sessions. Pages use a cursor: pass meta.next_cursor. Each export is itself recorded.

request.description: Newest first, last 7 days by default. Filters: from, to (Cairo dates), category, actor (staff id or system), action, entity_type, entity_id; cursor, per_page ≤ 100.
The next page after List Audit Log.
Only the Pricing category.
The 8 categories and whether Everything includes each.
One entry with the full before/after, reason, IP and device fingerprint. 404 when not visible to you.
CSV (UTF-8 with BOM) of every matching entry, capped at 50,000 (X-Export-Truncated). Recorded as audit.log.exported.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Customer API. Access endpoints use the customer access_token (ability customer:access); Customer Refresh uses the customer refresh_token (ability customer:refresh). A staff token is rejected with 401.

request.description: Step 1 of the six-step registration. Validates name/phone/password, hashes the password server-side and sends a phone OTP by SMS. Saves the returned registration_ref into {{registration_ref}}. No customer row is created here.
Step 2. Marks the session phone-verified. Idempotent — a retry after success succeeds unchanged.
Step 3. Attaches email + Egyptian governorate to the session and sends an email OTP. Uniqueness is rechecked at submit time.
Step 4. Marks the session email-verified.
Step 5. multipart/form-data. Egyptian ID needs front+back; passport needs front only. Files land encrypted on the private disk under identity-pending/{ref}/.

Step 6. Creates the customer as pending_verification with the pending identity document. Does NOT issue a session — the customer must wait for staff approval before any login. Response contains { data: { customer, status: "pending_verification" } }.
DEPRECATED. Always returns 410 registration_endpoint_deprecated. Use /register/submit instead. Creates nothing, issues no session, sends no notifications.

Phone + password. From a trusted device → 200 with customer + session. From a new device → 200 with data.otp_required=true, challenge_id, expires_at, resend_available_at, and an SMS code is sent (local env: 123456); finish with Customer Login — Verify OTP from the same X-Device-Id. Missing X-Device-Id → 401 invalid_credentials. Pending/rejected/suspended → 403. 429 account_locked after 5 failures per phone in 15 minutes.

Releases a sign-in held for a new device: correct SMS code → 200 with customer + session, and this X-Device-Id becomes trusted (next login skips the code). 401 otp_invalid (wrong code, voided after 5 wrong attempts, or another device) / otp_expired. Must use the same X-Device-Id as the login.
Sends a fresh SMS code on the pending challenge. 429 too_many_requests within the 60 s cooldown (Retry-After set) or after 5 codes on one challenge.

Uses the customer refresh_token (ability customer:refresh) as the Bearer credential; the access_token is rejected here with 403. The refresh token rotates on every use — replaying an old one returns 401 refresh_invalid and revokes the whole token family.

item.name: Identity
item.description: Customer API — private ID upload and identity document submission. Uses the customer access_token. Flow: Upload ID Image (stores upload_token) → Submit Identity Document (stores document_id). The customer stays unverified until staff approve it (see Dashboard Identity).

request.description: Pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (max 8 MB). It is stored encrypted on a private disk; the response carries a single-use upload_token, saved to the upload_token variable. Rate limit: customer.uploads (10/min).

doc_kind is egyptian_id or passport (anything else is 422 unsupported_doc_kind). Creates a pending document; 409 document_already_pending if one is already waiting; 422 upload_token_invalid for an unknown/expired/used/foreign token.
